subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative unit coverage as sufficient proof for this provider-side xAI/Grok decrypt error, or require an organic after-fix capture before merge?
rationale: The contributor plausibly explains that the exact code-less xAI error depends on provider-side model/key rotation and cannot be forced on demand, but ClawSweeper's normal external-PR gate requires after-fix real behavior proof unless maintainers override it.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Treat the pre-fix logs, SDK-shaped source repro, focused positive/negative tests, and existing sibling retry proof as enough for this non-inducible provider failure, then merge after normal freshness checks.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until the contributor can attach redacted gateway logs or terminal output from a real xAI/Grok rotation event showing the stripped retry succeeds.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and pause this PR if maintainers want a broader provider-error classification design instead of another predicate extension.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the pre-fix logs, SDK-shaped source repro, focused positive/negative tests, and existing sibling retry proof as enough for this non-inducible provider failure, then merge after normal freshness checks.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored and merged the sibling encrypted-reasoning retry path and is the best available owner for deciding whether this proof exception is acceptable.
